name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
description: An Echoverse werewolf Edgar Markov, who united the howlpacks and was once imprisoned in the Helvault by his grandson Sorin.

timeline.summary: Edgar's grandson Sorin betrays him by imprisoning him in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Edgar's own grandson Sorin, while in his human form, betrayed Edgar by creating and imprisoning him in the Helvault

timeline.summary: Avacyn imprisons her sisters in the Helvault with Edgar Markov and Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She imprisoned them in the Helvault with the foul Edgar Markov and sinister Griselbrand, where they might contemplate their folly.
